title: Structured-note term sheet extraction schema, v1 (FROZEN 2026-09-11)
description: Every field is extracted WITH a citation or explicitly DECLARED_ABSENT. `critical` drives finding severity. Normalization rules live in normalize.py, never here and never in a prompt.

fields.name: trade_id
fields.description: Desk/booking trade identifier as printed on the term sheet (e.g. 'SN-2026-0417').

fields.name: issuer
fields.description: Legal issuer name.

fields.name: notional
fields.description: Aggregate principal amount, numeric. '10,000,000' -> 10000000; 'USD 10mm' -> 10000000.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Three-letter ISO-4217 code of the notional.

fields.name: trade_date
fields.description: Trade / pricing date, ISO-8601.

fields.name: issue_date
fields.description: Issue / settlement date of the note, ISO-8601.

fields.name: maturity_date
fields.description: Scheduled maturity / final redemption date, ISO-8601.

fields.name: underlyings
fields.description: Bloomberg tickers of the underlying(s), e.g. ['SX5E', 'SPX']. Order as listed in the document.

fields.name: initial_level_pct
fields.description: Initial reference level as percent of spot on the strike date. Almost always 100.

fields.name: barrier_type
fields.description: Knock-in barrier observation style. 'observed at maturity only' -> european; 'continuously observed' -> american.

fields.name: barrier_level_pct
fields.description: Knock-in barrier as percent of initial level. If the document has no barrier level, DECLARE ABSENT — never guess.

fields.name: coupon_rate_pct
fields.description: Coupon rate AS WRITTEN in the document, with the period it is quoted for captured in coupon_rate_basis. Normalization to per-annum is done in code.

fields.name: coupon_rate_basis
fields.description: Whether coupon_rate_pct is quoted per annum or per coupon period. Companion to coupon_rate_pct; not compared to booking directly.

fields.name: coupon_frequency
fields.description: Coupon payment frequency.

fields.name: coupon_memory
fields.description: True if missed coupons are recoverable at a later observation (memory / snowball / catch-up clause).

fields.name: autocall_observation_dates
fields.description: Scheduled autocall observation dates, ISO-8601, in order. Absent if the note is not autocallable.

fields.name: autocall_level_pct
fields.description: Autocall trigger level(s) as percent of initial. A single number if flat; a list aligned to observation dates if stepping.

fields.name: day_count
fields.description: Day count fraction convention for coupon accrual.

fields.name: settlement
fields.description: Settlement method at maturity.

fields.name: business_day_convention
fields.description: Business day adjustment convention.

per_field.value: typed per field; null iff DECLARED_ABSENT

citation.text_span: verbatim substring of the source document

per_field.note: optional free text from the extractor (never used by the comparator)

invariants: Every schema field appears exactly once.
status == EXTRACTED  => value is non-null AND citation.text_span is a verbatim substring of the document.
status == DECLARED_ABSENT => value is null AND citation is null.
A field that is missing from the output, or has null value with status EXTRACTED, is a MALFORMED_EXTRACTION finding — never a blank.

history.note: Initial freeze. Added coupon_rate_basis (not in INSTRUCTIONS table) so the G09 per-quarter/per-annum trap is resolved in normalize.py from an extracted fact, not from prompt-side arithmetic.
